annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: Paying the hundred is how I'd insist that pay follows work.
correcting a lopsided deal means moving money back toward the person who earned it
A penalty sized to the broken bargain sits right with me.
Squaring a trade should mean restoring what was owed
When two people shake on a job, each owes the other their part.
it doesn't bring us closer to equal footing
Taking back unearned pay is setting the record straight
Making things right, to me, means correcting both ends of the trade.
it's the one step on offer toward the balance we both signed up for
If you take a share, you owe the effort that goes with it.
